description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Physical Mutation

You move like a combination of a predator and a dancer, your body a serpentine whirl o motion on the battle eld as you move among your opponents. You gain +5 WS, +10 Agility and the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.NDetl9BhAQBVnHKf]{Combat Master} and @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.SgjJMBgc85aswvhm]{Relentless} Talents. Your unnatural grace makes it hard for you to blend in with a crowd. You get a -10 modifier when trying to use Stealth to blend in among people.
